title: THE CORAL CAUSEWAY
notes: Painted scenery (revision 3, step D): the 4 st3 paintings (work/bg/gen/st3 -> strips tools/art/strips/st3, prompts tools/art/bg-prompts.json). a0 and a1 are driving loops of one painting each (strip A, strip B overlapping 32 px with a crossfade; the B strip's tail fades over x 0..32, so the wrap is a crossfade too); a2 (on foot) is the four strips of a2-1 and a2-2 in storyline order, overlapping 32 px with a floor-only crossfade, ending on the bridge deck (Krag's arena).

Gameplay structure (sections, lock counts, task props, casts, boss lock) from step B. The paintings put the two drive legs first (a0 coastal highway, a1 low-tide causeway) and the checkpoint on foot last, so 3-3 moved into a1 and 3-4..3-6 into a2; 3-6 keeps its drive flag (campaign.js): the Cadillac drives past Krag's parked hauler onto the bridge, where the boss lock stops the convoy.
